{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only doc/release-notes-xxxxx.md to document the removal of the -mempoolexpiry option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note updates that accompany code changes are excluded from the documentation category."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/mempool_options.h and src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.* only to remove expiry-related options and removal reasons.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to kernel header options and enums are purely mechanical updates following the removal of mempool expiry."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Mempool label; deletes entry_time index from txmempool and removes time-based eviction logic across mempool files.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing time-based mempool eviction fixes an incentive-incompatibility where still-mineable transactions are evicted and eliminates per-entry index memory overhead. As noted in issue #33510 and the description, age-based eviction 'can drop still-mineable transactions, such as a low-feerate parent waiting on a fee-bumping child' while deleting the index lowers per-entry memory usage."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test runners and fuzz harnesses only to update tests for the removed expiry behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Modifications to tests and fuzz targets directly follow from the mempool feature removal rather than changes to test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to handle -mempoolexpiry as a deprecated no-op option.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Argument handling changes whose sole purpose is one subsystem's configuration belong to that subsystem rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp to drop expiry check calls from validation loops.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to validation files that simply remove mempool eviction calls belong to mempool rather than validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py to adapt to transactions not being expired from the mempool.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test updates adjusting wallet functional tests to account for transactions staying in the mempool do not constitute wallet changes."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
